_comment: Every number here carries its evidence grade. The sandbox that produced this file could not fetch any *.atlassian.com page, so Atlassian figures are ASSUMED (search-reported), a web-search summary of the cited page. Re-grade to VERIFIED only after reading the cited URL yourself. See docs/spikes/01-forge-llm-cost-model.md, 'Confirm locally'.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.note: Equals Anthropic's first-party list price per the claude-api skill's cached table (2026-09-25).

models.label: Claude Sonnet 4.5
models.note: Sonnet-tier price; Anthropic lists Sonnet 4.6 at the same $3/$15.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.evidence: ASSUMED (parity with Anthropic list; Forge's own price for this model was NOT found)
models.source: claude-api skill cached model table, 2026-09-25 (local file, not a Forge price)
models.note: Forge lists this model as supported (search-reported) but no Forge price for it was returned. Parity with Anthropic's list is an inference from the three models whose Forge price matches Anthropic's list.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.6
models.note: Opus 4.7 and 4.8 are listed by Anthropic at the same $5/$25; Forge's price for them was not found.

forge_credits.note: The search summary printed these as 'credits per 1M tokens'; only 'credits per token' is arithmetically consistent with the dollar prices (tests/test_cost_model.py checks this).

forge_platform.llm_compute_inflation_note: RFC-117 clarification (search-reported): a Forge LLM call raises Forge Functions compute 15x to 27x versus typical apps, because the function waits for the model; compute (GB-seconds) is billed separately from tokens. https://community.developer.atlassian.com/t/rfc-117-clarification-on-forge-llms-compute-usage-and-pricing/98220

forge_llm_limits.note: Whether TPM counts input+output is not stated in the summary; the model assumes it does (conservative).

billing_party.statement: Forge LLM usage is charged to the developer of the Forge app and counted toward the developer's Forge monthly bill; there is no free monthly quota.

marketplace_revenue_share.interpretation: ASSUMED: the 'revenue share rate' is the share the partner KEEPS, so Atlassian's take is 1 - rate (17% from 2026-10-01).
marketplace_revenue_share.note: The 100% rate is described as being for qualifying Runs on Atlassian apps. Forge remotes are allowed for the Forge rate, but whether a remote-backed app also gets the 100% window was NOT established.
